title: hopsesh's OpenCode plugin: notice-hook input
description: What hopsesh's OpenCode plugin (agents/opencode/plugin/hopsesh.js) writes to the standard input of `hopsesh notice-hook --agent opencode`: the session (its root session, for a subagent's), the folder its OpenCode server runs in, and the event (UserPromptSubmit for a prompt or a tool call, SessionStart after session.created, session.moved or session.forked). hopsesh answers one JSON object: {"block":false}, {"block":false,"context":...} or {"block":true,"reason":...}. The file lives in opencode/<OpenCode version>/notice/<event>/.
